overview_description.description:
We use AI to help you write high-quality patents quickly. We do this by providing a simple in-browser document editor that any patent attorney or inventor can start using straight away.

Our product can help with all stages of the patent life cycle, from drafting and filing to prosecution and opposition.

If you are an an inventor, a patent attorney, or even just an enthusiast interested in the intersection of AI and intellectual property, we would love to hear from you: https://www.solveintelligence.com/contact

about_short_description.short_description: Solve Intelligence is an artifical intelligence company that offers generative AI technology for writing patents.

product.name: Patent Application Drafting
product.description: AI-assisted drafting for patent applications, including claims, specifications, figures, chemical structures, and biological sequences across application types and jurisdictions.

product.name: Patent Prosecution
product.description: AI-assisted analysis and drafting for office action responses, claim amendments, objections, rejections, prior art, and supporting legal citations.

product.name: Claim Charts
product.description: An AI tool for generating and reviewing claim charts, including invalidity, infringement, freedom-to-operate, SEP, claim construction, product mapping, and portfolio analyses.

product.name: Invention Harvesting
product.description: A workflow for generating, customizing, submitting, and managing invention disclosure forms for inventors and research and development teams.
